scope: Theorem 10.18 (Rigidity of a finite port comparison) of the manuscript “Canonical conformal limits of subcritical FK planar maps” (preprints/Canonical-conformal-limits-of-subcritical-FK-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e7dab39caf778176), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 104. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every limiting law satisfying (10.7) has coincident optimal constants c = C = λ, where 0 < λ < ∞ is deterministic. In every ordinary open chart, FU (x, y) = λDh(x, y; U). The lower comparison applies to all certificates; the upper comparison has the complete ordered-port meaning of Definition 10.4.
